program: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) — Florida's manual still uses the older "Food Stamps (FS)" name internally
agency: Florida Department of Children and Families (DCF)
admin_note: State-administered: DCF runs SNAP directly; there are no independent county eligibility agencies. Policy lives in the ACCESS Florida Program Policy Manual (CFOP 165-22), organized by 4-digit chapter number where the middle two digits identify the program — any chapter ending in "10" (0210, 0610, 1610, 1810, 2410, 2610, 3210...) is the Food Stamps program section of that chapter. Chapters are amended in place (no numbered bulletin/release series analogous to Illinois' MR or Michigan's BPB was found in this pass — see PROVENANCE.md).
system: MyACCESS (public application/case-management portal); FloridaCommerce/CareerSource administers SNAP Employment & Training referrals

update_channels.name: Florida Administrative Code Rule 65A-1.603 (utility standards; Florida Department of State eRulemaking gateway)

verification.method: Direct fetch of the ACCESS Florida manual's Food-Stamps-relevant chapters (ffic.myflfamilies.com/manual/*.pdf, plain curl, stable numeric filenames — no leading zero on 3-digit chapter codes, a quirk this pass had to discover by trial) + Florida Administrative Code Rule 65A-1.603 (flrules.org, browser-header curl) + the DCF ABAWD FAQ page + USDA FNA's authoritative Restaurant Meals Program state list and ABAWD waiver-response file index, cross-checked against the already-verified #619 engine sourcing for FL's drug-felony and SUA figures.
verification.gates: Cross-check: every pivotal dollar value and eligibility rule traced to its own manual chapter, F.A.C. rule page, or federal authoritative list (not a curated extract) before drafting. Two production findings surfaced and filed (not fixed — packages/snap-rules stays parked): #708 (FL's abawd_waiver_avail may be stale, no waiver-response file on record for FY25/FY26) and a bonus WA finding (#707, WA's rmp_operated contradicted by the same federal RMP list checked for FL). Refute gate recorded in PROVENANCE.md.
